answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 37517 Country: Pakistan Title: By profession I deal with many laws, there is a principal of law that "whatever is not prohibited is permitted". Question: By profession I deal with many laws, there is a principal of law that "whatever is not prohibited is permitted". Is this principal applicable in Shariah laws as well? Answer ID: 37517 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 412/343/B=1433) In Shariah, a thing is permissible which is neither prohibited nor is a source of prohibition. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
